run_pybleuscorer_score: run PyBleuScorer to calculate BLEU score between a reference corpus and output corpus
run_pybleuscorer_precision: run PyBleuScorer precision method to calculate n-gram precision for a reference and output sentence
create_sent_ngrams_list: create a list of all n-grams from a sentence using sent_ngrams_list with a given n value
run_tokenize_corpus: run tokenize on a corpus to split sentences into lists of word tokens
run_lower_corpus: run lower on a corpus or string to convert all text to lowercase case-insensitively
